NONE: › a long, loud, high call that is produced by a horse when it is excited or frightened
A2 someone who lives very close to you
B1 a country that is next to another country

example: Some of the neighbours have complained about the noise from our party.
有些鄰居已經抱怨過我們的聚會太喧鬧。
Have you met Pat, my next-door neighbour?
你見過我隔壁的鄰居派特嗎？
The relationship between Scotland and its southern neighbour (= England) has not always been peaceful.
蘇格蘭和南方鄰邦的關係並非一直很和睦。

NONE: B1 the area of a town that surrounds someone's home, or the people who live in this area
鄰近地區；住宅區，街區；街坊，四鄰

example: There were lots of kids in my neighbourhood when I was growing up.
我是在有很多孩子的街區裡長大的。
They live in a wealthy/poor/friendly neighbourhood.
他們生活在富裕／貧窮／和睦的街區。
I wouldn't like to live in the neighbourhood of (= in the area around) an airport.
我不會喜歡住在機場附近。

NONE: › a way of reducing crime by organizing the people who live in an area to watch each other's property and tell the police about possible criminals
居民聯防，鄰裡守護制，守望相助
B2 Neighbouring places are next to or near each other.

example: She married a man from the neighbouring village.
她嫁給了鄰村的一個人。

NONE: › friendly or helpful to your neighbours

example: It was very neighbourly of you to do her shopping for her.
你幫她到商店買東西，真是好心。

NONE: B2 not either of two things or people
B2 used when you want to say that two or more things are not true

example: We've got two TVs, but neither works properly.
我們有兩台電視，但沒有一台是好的。
Neither of my parents likes my boyfriend.
我父母都不喜歡我的男朋友。
Neither one of us is interested in gardening.
我們兩個都不太喜歡園藝。
"Which one would you choose?" "Neither. They're both terrible."
「你會挑哪個？」「兩個都不要，兩個都很糟糕。」
If she doesn't agree to the plan, neither will Tom (= he will also not).
如果她不同意這項計劃，湯姆也不會同意。
Chris wasn't at the meeting and neither was her assistant.
克裡斯沒有出席會議，她的助手也沒有。
informal "I don't feel like going out this evening." "Me neither."
「我今晚不想出去。」「我也是。」
On two occasions she was accused of stealing money from the company, but in neither case was there any evidence to support the claims.
她兩次被指控盜用公款，但兩次都沒有確鑿的證據。
Neither my mother nor my father went to university.
我父母都沒有上過大學。
They speak neither French nor German, but a strange mixture of the two.
他們說的既不是法語也不是德語，而是兩者的古怪混合。
I neither know nor care what happened to him.
我不知道，也不關心他出了甚麼事。
